svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Streaming analytics on Google Cloud
svg.desc: Streaming analytics on Google Cloud. 8 components in 3 groups. Connections: Store devices to Pub/Sub (publish); Web and mobile apps to Pub/Sub (publish); Pub/Sub to Dataflow (subscribe); Dataflow to BigQuery (streaming writes); Dataflow to Cloud Storage (raw files); Dataflow to Vertex AI (online prediction); BigQuery to Looker (SQL); BigQuery to Vertex AI (training data).

text.tspan: Events flow through Pub/Sub and Dataflow into BigQuery for Looker dashboards and Vertex AI models
